question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**from**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, we need to use a preposition to show the relationship between two parts of the sentence.
 
• We need to use the preposition **'from' **so that we can express the reason for deaths in the first part of the sentence with air pollution as the cause.
